requirements.requirement: The system must write normalized prescription records to the MongoDB collection PublicHealthData.prescriptions.
The system must batch write operations with a configurable batch size greater than 1.
The system must successfully insert all valid records in a batch when no errors occur.
The system must enforce idempotency such that re-processing the same input does not create duplicate records.
The system must generate a deterministic unique key per prescription record based on defined schema fields.
The system must perform upsert operations (insert or update) using the deterministic unique key.
The system must use MongoDB utilities defined in ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py for all database interactions.
The system must log the number of records processed, inserted, updated, and failed per batch.
The system must continue processing remaining batches after a successful batch write.
The system must validate that each record conforms to the schema defined in PIPE-RX-INGEST-S1 before writing.
The system must skip and log records that fail schema validation without halting the pipeline.
The system must retry a failed batch write at least once when a transient database error occurs.
The system must stop processing and surface an error when a non-recoverable database error occurs.
The system must ensure consistency with pipeline_worker_base.py patterns for execution flow and error handling.
